transformations.centroid: Area centroid of largest polygon outer ring; not population weighted
transformations.county_assignment: Point in polygon; pitch coordinates are OSM node or way/relation bounding-box center
transformations.missing: Invalid or missing tract observations omitted. All 159 county observations valid.
transformations.normalization: Min-max per metric within selected demand areas; equal values give 0. Weights normalize by sum; all-zero weights give equal priority.
transformations.priority_distance: Nearest non-unavailable mapped candidate within selected county scope, including user-excluded candidates; fixed across methods
transformations.cost: fixed + reserved places * variable cost, per activation, charged even if underfilled
transformations.allocations: Integer floor(eligible * takeup/100), reduced after allocation across waves
transformations.retention: round(modeled enrollment * retention/100) separate from allocation

limitations: Area-level socioeconomic proxies; not individual observations
County centroids substantially simplify within-county access outside five Atlanta counties
ACS age estimate assumes uniform distribution in 5–9 band; margins of error not propagated
OSM coverage incomplete; mapped fields unconfirmed and adjacent pitches may share a venue
All operating inputs illustrative or proposal references; no validated impact claims
Heuristic is not mathematically optimal; no travel-time or road routing model
Referee wages and coaching pipeline budgets excluded from Starter Squads delivery scope
